coverage.judicial: Only actual printed elected Surrogate included; no appointed or non-November judge contests invented.

coverage.writeInsAndStatuses: Generic Personal Choice/NO NOMINATION MADE/NO PETITION FILED spaces excluded from people. Final named-write-in certification and cancelled-office inventory not established, so no zero-write-in or countywide absence claim.
